explanation: I searched Mathlib/RingTheory/Valuation/Basic.lean. It has Valuation.map_add_eq_of_lt_left, map_add_lt, map_sum_lt and map_sum_eq_of_lt. None of them states this result directly. Getting the six-term statement from them means reassociating the sum and nesting map_add_lt four times to bound the tail. That is the library's own proof, and it takes more than one or two lines. map_sum_eq_of_lt would need the sum rewritten as a Finset sum, and that is not routine glue. I found no Mathlib lemma for "one dominant term plus five smaller terms".
